title: Three Months and One Short Notice
subtitle: 历史古迹 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：pyramid　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pyramid 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the warden ① studyed the pyramid that no resident in the centre would have recorded, and he said the studying was the whole of the month. The ② pyramid, meaning the tomb itself and not the notice, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; a pyramid, he said, is the only thing in a centre that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ pyramid in that centre had the same short notice beside it, and the ④ pyramid at the far gate, meaning the form they kept for the children to fill in and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A pyramid, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the warden said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the pyramid was the whole of the matter, meaning the mystery and not the tomb. The ⑥ pyramid, meaning the mystery and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; pyramid, he said, is either something you study or the only word that means both a tomb and a mystery. He said the mystery is the part they remember.

By 1981 the ⑦ pyramid had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short notice. The ⑧ pyramid of the whole thing, the warden wrote in June, was one centre and three months of recording; pyramid, he said, is either the form at the far gate or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ pyramid I remember is the tomb recorded in the register, which closed in 1983 and is still recorded as the quietest in the centre. A ⑩ pyramid, my mother said in 1985, is the only tomb that improves by being recorded; every pyramid, she said, is a mystery that has agreed to look like a tomb. She said the mystery was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 金字塔（指社区中心里每一座旁边的那一座）
B. n. 金字塔（指那座金字塔本身，与小小的告示相对）
C. 固定搭配：study the pyramid 考察这一座金字塔
D. n. 金字塔（指留给孩子们填的那一张）
E. n. 金字塔之事（抽象总称，指一处社区中心的金字塔之事）
F. n. 金字塔（指登记册里写到、被记载的那一座）
G. n. 金字塔、神秘（指一件事里人人都到却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 神秘（抽象总称，指人人都到却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: studyed the pyramid that no resident in the centre would have recorded
The pyramid, meaning the tomb itself and not the notice
the pyramid at the far gate
the pyramid was the whole of the matter
the pyramid had become a line in a register
The pyramid of the whole thing
A pyramid, my mother said in 1985

answers.why: study the pyramid 意为“考察这一座金字塔”，1976 年那位管理员把社区中心里没有一位居民肯记载的一座金字塔做了一遍。
pyramid 意为“金字塔”，指那座金字塔本身而不是小小的告示，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。
pyramid 意为“金字塔”，指社区中心里每一座旁边的那一座，每一座旁边都有同一张小小的告示。
pyramid 意为“金字塔”，指最远那道大门的留给孩子们填的那一张，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
pyramid 意为“金字塔、神秘”，指一件事里人人都到却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这座神秘就是那件事的全部。
pyramid 意为“神秘”，指人人都到却无人提起的那样东西而不是那座金字塔，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
pyramid 意为“金字塔”，指登记册里写到、被记载的那一座，到 1981 年这一座成了登记册里的一行。
pyramid 意为“金字塔之事”，管理员六月写道，整件事的金字塔之事是一处社区中心和三个月份的记载。
pyramid 意为“金字塔”，我记得的是登记册里记载过的那一座，1983 年办妥了，至今仍被说成社区中心里最安静的一座。
pyramid 为抽象总称，母亲 1985 年说，金字塔是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的金字塔。
